integrity: Analytic proof uses Jacobi orthogonality, strict zero interlacing, Christoffel transformation, min-max, and Mehler–Heine asymptotics. Exact rational finite matrix diagnostics were replayed. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All-order fixed-weight disk theorem; strict equality spaces are for the full polyanalytic space, not the true-order summand. The hard-edge asymptotic fixes alpha as q grows. Potential older equivalent Jacobi quadrature formulations may affect historical priority. Finite diagnostics supplement, not replace, classical orthogonal-polynomial arguments.
title: Sharp radial second-moment and first-angular-gap inequalities in weighted polyanalytic Bergman spaces
